scope: Additive validity gates over the frozen R26.12 difficulty and R26.9 metric contracts

diagnostic_input_contract.proof_only: Unlabeled union of positive and rejected proof spans for all five questions
diagnostic_input_contract.interpretation: Synthesis upper bound and recognition-gap diagnostic only

language_surface_contract.scope: R26.13 only; historical release rendering remains byte-stable
forbidden_degenerate_frames: The entry in the <source ending in entry>

level_confound_contract.diagnostic: leave-one-match-out private-level prediction from public question wording
level_confound_contract.interpretation: Level prediction is not answer extraction, but above-chance prediction reveals scenario-composition confounding.
level_confound_contract.difficulty_claim_rule: An unadjusted level curve cannot by itself support a causal difficulty interpretation when public wording predicts private levels above chance.

answer_prior_shortcut_contract.reason_for_addendum: Frozen before any valid R26.13 provider result after a static no-document baseline exposed that the 65% factual-field ceiling was nearly attainable from priors alone.
required_factual_companion_metrics: value-balanced accuracy over every value of each informative field
skill over the leave-one-match-out unconditional prior
answer_prior_shortcut_contract.failure_action: Block external model spending and build a versioned shadow candidate; do not overwrite R26.13 or silently change its frozen primary metric.

required_single_fault_separation: a factual mutation changes factual metrics but not evidence-only metrics
a missing proof edge changes edge and chain metrics but not factual metrics
a wrong relation with unchanged endpoints changes edge and chain metrics
a missing rejection edge changes rejection, edge and chain metrics
metric_sensitivity_addendum.interpretation: Micro edge F1 is retained for comparability but can be insensitive to one missing edge; question-exact and fact-plus-chain exact must be reported beside it.

claim_boundaries: Static PASS does not establish empirical difficulty.
Proof-only and position forms are paired diagnostics, not independent samples.
Public counterfactual wording creates measured level confounding; all empirical level claims require the matched-anchor diagnostic.
A factual-field ceiling is not meaningful when a no-document baseline approaches or exceeds it; the answer-prior gate must pass before provider calibration.
Changing public identifiers invalidates reuse of R26.12 provider responses.
No 220-match release is authorized before the frozen empirical calibration gates pass.
